evidence: script_reproduction: re-ran data/political_psychology.R's column-order row_number() over OSF yllanon.csv (404,595 long rows, identical to irw_fetch). Per-item non-NA n and mean identical for 36/37 items (e.g. 1 def 10549/3.40127, 12 vaccines 10699/2.13085, 27 votereport 534/2.03745, 28 voting 552/2.11232, 37 fourth 532/4.30263; max |mean diff| 0). Item 33 beh_identity 1397 raw vs 1362 live, the 35-row gap being exactly raw code 8 ('another party'), which the live build NA'd; with that level excluded all 245 live item x resp cells match cell for cell (0 mismatches). The 37 variables have distinct n/mean profiles, so any shift or permutation of the crosswalk would break the match; this distinguishes every item from every other. Text side: each item's shipped item_text contains the distinguishing phrase of its variable's codebook1.html entry, 37/37 (friends_1..5 Liberals/Conservatives/Moderates/Republicans/Democrats; beh_att_1..3 poor/economy/healthcare). Option axis: .qsf recode values = codebook value labels = the data's codes. Not established by this route: nothing further -- the variable->wording tie is by variable name in the study's own .qsf/codebook.

Route 8 + content-pair structure on live data (verify_bialowolski_2024_financial_literacy.R, PASS 7/7): easiest item FL_16 p=.958 = Q16 'inflation means cost of living rises'; two hardest FL_2 .166 and FL_10 .185 = Q2 bond prices and Q10 PLN 30 minimum payment on PLN 3,000 at 1%/month (never paid off), next hardest FL_3 .257; strongest pair in the 18x18 matrix FL_1-FL_12 r=.444 = the two 'less than today' inflation items; FL_13's and FL_15's top partner is FL_14 (r .389, .333) = open 0-interest item, 2% of PLN 100 item, and its 5-year continuation; FL_5<->FL_17 mutual top-2 (r .372) = the two diversification items; FL_19's top partners FL_11, FL_6 (risk items), consistent with Q18 risk-return. NOT established: FL_2 vs FL_10 order beyond both being hardest; order among unpaired mid-difficulty items FL_3, FL_4, FL_6, FL_7, FL_8, FL_9, FL_11 (r(7,8) only .189); and that FL_19 is Q18 rather than a question absent from the appendix. No published per-item statistics (paper closed, 403).
